text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was struck once again by stomach 
pain and abnormal breathing. Diagnosed 
with potentially multiple ailments, a full 
recovery would take six months.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rushing over, Verxina argues that it's 
better to rest and not enter any races 
until a full recovery is made, and the 
Trainer almost agrees with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Vivlos refuses to give up. She 
pleads with the two of them that she won't 
abandon the Triple Tiara or Dubai, moving 
their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And later on—when it was officially 
announced that Vivlos would take on the 
Tiara route, her fans rejoiced with 
immense delight.
